offline.title: Pending sales
offline.description: Cash sales made while offline are saved on this device and sent to the server in order. The server decides the final receipt number, stock and totals.
offline.syncFailed: Could not reach the server. Sales stay queued.
offline.offlineWaiting: You are offline. Queued sales will sync when the connection returns.
offline.attention: {count} sale(s) were rejected by the server and need a decision: retry or resolve them.
offline.otherCashier: Waiting for that cashier to sign in
offline.resolveDescription: Record how this sale was settled (for example refunded in cash and re-rung). The sale stays on record and is never deleted.
offline.resolveNeedsNote: A note is required to resolve a sale.
offline.empty: No offline sales on this device.
offline.rejectedToast: {count} offline sale(s) were rejected. Open Pending sales.

provisionalHint.queued: Saved on this device. The final receipt number is assigned when it syncs.
provisionalHint.synced: Synced. Use the final receipt for returns and records.
provisionalHint.rejected: The server rejected this sale. Open Pending sales to resolve it.
provisionalHint.resolved: This rejected sale was resolved by staff.

offline.notFound: This offline sale is not on this device.

stocktakes.title: Stocktakes
stocktakes.description: Count stock in full or by category. Entering counts never changes stock; only an admin's approval does, and every adjustment is recorded as a stock movement.
stocktakes.newDescription: Expected quantities are frozen when the count starts, so sales during the count are surfaced for review instead of silently skewing it.
stocktakes.scanHint: Scan a barcode to add one unit to that line (kg items: type the weight). Entries save automatically; you can pause and resume at any time.
stocktakes.notInCount: Barcode {barcode} is not part of this count.
stocktakes.awaitingApproval: This count is waiting for an admin to review and approve it.
stocktakes.cancelledNotice: This count was cancelled. No stock was changed.
stocktakes.conflictsNotice: {count} line(s) had stock movements after the count started. Choose how to settle each one.
stocktakes.resolveFirst: Resolve {count} flagged line(s) to enable approval.

purchaseOrders.title: Purchase orders
purchaseOrders.newDescription: Costs are per unit, excluding VAT, in EGP. The order is saved as a draft; place it when it is sent to the supplier.
purchaseOrders.closedDone: Order closed. The remainder will not be received.
purchaseOrders.receiveDescription: Receive part or all of the order. Over-receipt is allowed only up to {pct}% above the ordered quantity. Stock and average cost update once per receipt.
purchaseOrders.receivedCostNote: Costs are the invoiced prices at receipt, excluding VAT; VAT uses each line's rate. Sales profit uses the cost snapshot taken at sale time.
